t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pick 3 gnome colors and stick with them until their numbers start to decrease.

vb_textbox.text: There are 4 pairs of gnomes that always stick together. Remember which colors are paired with which. Then find which color from the pair gives you the best returns. If you notice that you are getting smaller returns immediately switch to the opposite gnome in the pair. After every round you should start over and try and find the best gnome for each pair from scratch.
